description:
### New
- **Repair broken gallery images**: galleries that fail to load because Reddit marks some images as failed show their images again.
- **Keep reply box above keyboard**: the comment reply box, including its buttons, stays visible above the keyboard.
- **Fix broken markdown links**: links like `[name](u/name)` show as links instead of raw text.
- **Hide blocked mod comments**: a setting to hide mod comments (such as pinned bot comments) from users you've blocked. Off by default.
- **Inline comment images**: optional maximum width and height for inline images and videos (Settings → ReVanced). (#3)

### Fixes
- rif golden platinum no longer crashes when refreshing the front page.
- Inline video sound no longer cuts out, and muted videos stay silent when they loop.
- Comment videos that failed to load are retried instead of staying a plain link.
- The full-screen button on videos no longer shows a link popup.
- Inline GIFs no longer crash rif on Android 10. (#4)
- `http://` Matrix image links show inline.

Requires rif is fun **5.6.22** (free or Golden Platinum), patched together with the official ReVanced bundle's **Spoof client** patch. [notBrian2/revanced-rif-fixes](https://github.com/notBrian2/revanced-rif-fixes) is recommended alongside it.
